Two coupled amends: (1) redesign readiness gate 3 from the sustained-blind mean_beta_elevated_steps proxy to a SUSTAINED-HOLD proxy -- longest consecutive beta-elevated run on the OFF arm, or mean per-commit hold length total_beta_elevated/max(1,beta_release_events) -- above a floor, so the gate certifies the 460h monolithic-hold regime IS present before the co-occurrence DV is allowed; (2) establish the sustained-hold regime in eval -- diagnose which release mechanism fragments the OFF-baseline latch to ~1 tick (Leg-B committed-run-scaled de-commit refractory vs MECH-342 maintenance-release vs closure releases vs marginal running_variance flicker around the natural commit threshold) and either re-establish the F-decisive strong-commit regime the 460h finding described or make the OFF baseline actually sustain. Until a sustained natural-commit hold exists in the OFF arm, the rung-6 urgency lever (and the disjoint-certifier problem it dissolves) cannot be exercised.

learning_extracted: The lever was correctly armed (config + runtime): lever_present=true on the 3 armed arms; note_commit_entry was reached on NATURAL result.committed commits (sd034_n_closure_coupled_elevations=0 AND sd034_n_closure_commit_intent=0 prove the elevations were not closure-coupled). NOT a config-toggle gap.

The lever fired zero because the natural-commit latch is fragmented to ~1-tick blips (total_beta_elevated ~= beta_release_events, ~35 re-commits/episode); the urgency accumulator resets per fresh entry and cannot reach release_bound over ~1 tick, and action-extent never completes a sequence in ~1 tick.

ROOT CAUSE: the 460h sustained monolithic natural-commit-hold regime did not reproduce in the 460i eval; ARM_LEVER_OFF also cycles ~1-tick, so the active de-commit control-plane (Leg-B refractory + MECH-342 + closure releases) fragments the latch, not the lever -- there was no sustained occupancy to shorten.

Readiness gate 3's occupancy proxy (mean_beta_elevated_steps) is blind to sustained-vs-fragmented occupancy and green-lit a fragmented regime; it must be replaced with a sustained-hold proxy (longest consecutive elevated run, or mean per-commit hold length).
Seed 42 formed zero commits at all (total_committed_steps=0; hazard_stage_survival_pass=false) -- an independent nav-competence under-train on that seed, separate from the lever question.

The self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue / non_contributory is correct; the route_reason label (lever_did_not_shorten_occupancy) is accurate but the deeper cause is a regime mismatch, not the lever being broken -- the V3-EXQ-642 fresh-substrate-mislabel pattern, resolved toward re-queue/amend not ceiling.
